ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines AB and CD intersect at point O, $\angle 1 = 35^\circ$, $\angle 2 = 75^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle EOB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.title: MM-Math open-ended problem
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: As shown in the figure, lines AB and CD intersect at point O, with $\angle 1 = 35^\circ$ and $\angle 2 = 75^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle EOB$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: Given that $\angle 1 = 35^\circ$, $\angle BOD = \angle 1 = 35^\circ$. Therefore, $\angle EOB = \angle 2 + \angle BOD = 75^\circ + 35^\circ = \boxed{110^\circ}$.
